description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing a tree UI component using Ext JS framework, including features like saving/restoring tree state, drag & drop support, and AJAX interactions for node repositioning within a test management interface.

classes.name: TreePanelState
classes.description: A class managing the save and restore of tree panel state using local storage, including handling expand/collapse events.

methods.name: writeNodePositionToDB
methods.description: Sends AJAX requests to update node position or parent in the backend database based on drag & drop actions.

methods.name: TreePanelState.init
methods.description: Initializes the state object by retrieving saved state from local storage.

methods.name: TreePanelState.saveState
methods.description: Saves the current tree state to local storage.

methods.name: TreePanelState.onExpand
methods.description: Updates the saved state when a node is expanded.

methods.name: TreePanelState.onCollapse
methods.description: Updates the saved state when a node is collapsed.

methods.name: TreePanelState.restoreState
methods.description: Restores the tree to the last saved state, expanding paths accordingly.
